Just experienced a gesture of kindness.

I had a doctor's appointment this afternoon. Coming in, I noticed a woman's car had broken down in a lane of traffic with very heavy flow. Smoke was coming out of the hood. She was scared.

The receptionist came out. I told the lady to put the car in neutral and that the receptionist and I would try to push it into the lot.

Neither of us is that strong. We managed to get it going but very slowly.

Out of nowhere, 2 young guys pull into the lot in 2 separate cars. They jump out and instantly start to help us push the car and driver to safety.

As the driver is waiting for a tow another patient comes in. He's decent with cars and checks hers out. Figures out that her hose is busted. He calls around, gets her a new one and installs it. Saves her a trip to the mechanic. Yay for nice people!
Good guys helped us push a broken down car to safety
That is exactly what happens in an ideal world. What a great moment, for the right people to show up and do their bit. Really great!
